ideas.name: any warning between the session and RTH VWAPs
ideas.why: between the overnight-inclusive VWAP and the day's own VWAP, the two groups' average prices disagree: a contested zone where turns rotate

ideas.name: any warning with the forming 5m bar moving its way
ideas.why: the 5m bar in progress (its open to this minute's close) already moving the called way: the slower chart's traders see the turn start

ideas.name: any warning on a Friday
ideas.why: positions are squared before the weekend, so Friday moves are given back more than built on

ideas.name: any warning calling toward the overnight midpoint
ideas.why: the overnight range's middle is where overnight inventory is balanced; away from it, turns back toward it are inventory unwinding

ideas.name: any warning with VWAP flat
ideas.why: #2 says the drift's direction matters; with no drift (VWAP moved under a tenth of a 5m ATR in 15 minutes) both ways should rotate
